ffr-reach-network-v1.title: Free flowing river reaches, figshare v1

thumbnail.title: Sampled display-only overview; not an analytic asset

description: Analytic GeoParquet conversion of the full global free-flowing river reach network from the pinned 2019 figshare v1 source. Original source fields and WKB geometries, nulls, row order, and record multiplicity are preserved. Added columns expose the producer-stream row ordinal and per-feature EPSG:4326 bounds. This release does not assess scientific validity or update the source assessment.

table:columns.description: Esri-generated feature identifier; unique row identifier within this release.
table:columns.name: OBJECTID

table:columns.description: River reach identifier used to link to HydroATLAS.
table:columns.name: REACH_ID

table:columns.description: Global object identifier used to identify a reach across free-flowing-river assessments and link dams to reaches.
table:columns.name: GOID

table:columns.description: Network object identifier; same purpose as GOID.
table:columns.name: NOID

table:columns.description: One or more upstream NOIDs separated by underscores; an empty value identifies a headwater reach.
table:columns.name: NUOID

table:columns.description: Next downstream NOID; zero denotes a terminal reach.
table:columns.name: NDOID

table:columns.description: Continent identifier: 1 North America, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Africa, 5 Asia, 6 Australia.
table:columns.name: CON_ID

table:columns.description: Continent name; boundaries are delineated from HydroBASINS.
table:columns.name: CONTINENT

table:columns.description: Country name.
table:columns.name: COUNTRY

table:columns.description: HydroSHEDS hydrological river basin identifier.
table:columns.name: BAS_ID

table:columns.description: Hydrological basin name when available.
table:columns.name: BAS_NAME

table:columns.description: Length of the river reach.
table:columns.name: LENGTH_KM

table:columns.description: Volume of the reach channel, calculated from width, length, and depth.
table:columns.name: VOLUME_TCM

table:columns.description: Upstream watershed area of the river reach.
table:columns.name: UPLAND_SKM

table:columns.description: Average long-term (1971–2000) naturalized discharge.
table:columns.name: DIS_AV_CMS

table:columns.description: River order calculated from long-term average discharge using logarithmic classes.
table:columns.name: RIV_ORD

table:columns.description: Erosion yield summed within the river reach catchment; not accumulated along the network.
table:columns.name: ERO_YLD_TON

table:columns.description: Presence (1) or absence (0) of one or more waterfalls along the reach.
table:columns.name: HYFALL

table:columns.description: Backbone river identifier for a contiguous source-to-terminus flow path.
table:columns.name: BB_ID

table:columns.description: Backbone river name.
table:columns.name: BB_NAME

table:columns.description: Backbone river length, the sum of its reach lengths.
table:columns.name: BB_LEN_KM

table:columns.description: Discharge order of the most downstream reach in the backbone river.
table:columns.name: BB_DIS_ORD

table:columns.description: Backbone river volume, the sum of its reach volumes.
table:columns.name: BB_VOL_TCM

table:columns.description: Indicates whether the backbone river is directly connected to the ocean (1) or not (0).
table:columns.name: BB_OCEAN

table:columns.description: Analysis filter: Grill et al. (2019) included reaches with value 1 in analysis results.
table:columns.name: INC

table:columns.description: Degree of fragmentation pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: DOF

table:columns.description: Degree of regulation pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: DOR

table:columns.description: Sediment trapping pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: SED

table:columns.description: Water consumption pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: USE

table:columns.description: Urbanization pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: URB

table:columns.description: Road construction pressure index (0–100%).
table:columns.name: RDD

table:columns.description: Inundation (floodplain) extent in the river reach catchment (%).
table:columns.name: FLD

table:columns.description: Connectivity Status Index (0–100%); 100% is full connectivity.
table:columns.name: CSI

table:columns.description: Dominant pressure factor; documented values include DOF, DOR, SED, USE, RDD, and URB.
table:columns.name: CSI_D

table:columns.description: Indicates whether CSI is below (0) or above (1) the 95% free-flowing threshold.
table:columns.name: CSI_FF

table:columns.description: Two-category free-flowing status: free-flowing (1) or non-free-flowing (3).
table:columns.name: CSI_FF1

table:columns.description: Three-category status: free-flowing (1), good connectivity (2), or impacted (3).
table:columns.name: CSI_FF2

table:columns.description: Identifier for contiguous river stretches.
table:columns.name: CSI_FFID

table:columns.description: Length value maintained by the ESRI File Geodatabase; see LENGTH_KM for reach length.
table:columns.name: Shape_Length

table:columns.description: Source MultiLineString reach geometry, stored as WKB without coordinate transformation.
table:columns.name: Shape

table:columns.description: One-based ordinal of this feature in the producer's source layer stream, retained to make source order explicit.
table:columns.name: source_row

table:columns.description: Derived per-feature bounding box computed from the unchanged Shape WKB in the source CRS EPSG:4326. Child coordinates are longitude/latitude degrees; bounds are [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax].
table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
